title_line: SabreNdc / EGY - TestCases_V1.csv (V1 flows and endpoint cases) - Round 2
scope_text: Round 2 - 59 test cases from TestCases_V1.csv (24 flows x positive/negative + 11 endpoint cases): SabreNdc / EGY on staging, first V1 run on SabreNdc
description_text: V1 flows and V1 endpoint cases run against SabreNdc with the EGY credentials selector (flight date 2026-11-24, the collection-default passenger mix of 2 adults + 2 children + 2 infants on the flows). The CSV names TravelportNdc, Emirates, EgyptAir, AirCairo, AirArabia and FlyNas as flow suppliers; this run substitutes SabreNdc/EGY, so rows that need a different supplier, a bundle-capable offer or an expired hold are reported as blocked, each with its reason.

steps: Re-ran the SPEC 4.7 capability confirmation for SabreNdc/EGY before opening Round 2: Search on 6 routes (2026-11-24) read the per-offer flags on 91 offers: haveBundles, offerHasAncillary and isSeatMapRequired are false on every offer, canBeHeld is true on every offer.
V1 Upselling returns 200 with an upsellOffers[] ladder (no selectedOffer); V1 and V2 GetOfferBundles return 409 OperationNotSupported ("SabreNdc does not exists").
Confirmed that a 2 ADT + 2 CHD + 2 INF V1 Search / FareConfirm / Book / Retrieve / Void chain works (6 tickets), so the flows use the collection-default passenger mix.
Concluded that the Bundle-enriched flows (13-24) are blocked, that Upselling-based flows need the upsellOffers[0] workaround, and that the no-bundle flows 1-12 run.
